summary.description: What was done and the outcome, in 2-4 sentences of plain prose. Facts only; no pasted code, markup or long lists (those go in evidence).

evidence.description: Optional. The exact text the instruction asked for: code or markup lines, file paths with line numbers, search results. Plain text, one item per line, with forward slashes in paths. Leave it out when nothing was asked for.

changed_files.description: A LIST of objects, one per file you added, modified or deleted. Empty list if none. Example: [{"path": "src/app/main.ts", "change": "modified"}].

path.description: Project-relative path with forward slashes (src/app/main.ts), never backslashes.

tests.description: An OBJECT, not text. Example: {"ran": true, "passed": 12, "failed": 0}. Set ran to false when you did not run tests in this turn.

problems.description: A LIST of short strings, one problem per item: anything blocking, surprising or risky. Empty list if none.

question.description: Required when status=needs_input. The specific decision or information needed.
